channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Kassab diz que Bolsonaro 'teve desempenho pessoal muito aquém das expectativas'
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, criticized President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and former President Jair Bolsonaro during a business lunch organized by Grupo Lide in São Paulo. He stated that Bolsonaro had a 'personal performance well below expectations' and emphasized that the PSD is 'doing its part,' despite former governor Ronaldo Caiado not advancing to the presidential runoff.

item.title: O apelo de Daniel Silveira a Moraes para voltar a usar redes sociais
item.description: Former federal deputy Daniel Silveira again requested STF authorization to access social media, but Minister Alexandre de Moraes referred the request to the PGR for a five-day opinion, after previously denying it. Silveira’s defense filed a regimental appeal, now under review. He also had denied a request to flexibilize his open regime schedule to study law at night, with Moraes stating restrictions do not block education access.

item.title: Kassab diz que PSD dá apoio “incondicional” a Tarcísio em São Paulo
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, reaffirmed the party's unconditional support for Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) in his re-election bid in São Paulo, ruling out any alliance with the PT. He emphasized that the PSD was the first party to back Tarcísio and expressed satisfaction and active involvement in the campaign, despite recent developments such as the vice-governor Felício Ramuth switching to the MDB and Kassab's departure from the Governor's Office.

item.title: Flávio faz primeiro ato de pré-campanha com Tarcísio e diz que governador será presidente 'um dia'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, held his first pre-campaign event alongside São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans), praising the governor's future potential to become president 'one day'. The meeting took place on Monday, April 27, 2026, and featured mutual compliments and pledges of unity between the two Bolsonarist leaders.

item.title: Lula cancela participação em compromissos públicos após procedimento cirúrgico
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) canceled his participation in two public commitments after undergoing a surgical procedure. He missed the Workers' Party congress and did not deliver the scheduled videoconference speech at a family farming event, as originally planned.

item.title: Flávio diz que MDB “está mais perto” da gente que do outro lado
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated that the MDB is politically closer to his bloc than to Lula’s government, citing support from figures like Mayor Ricardo Nunes and Vice Governor Felício Ramuth. He made the remarks during the opening of Agrishow 2026 in Ribeirão Preto, where he appeared alongside São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos). The MDB, represented by its president Baleia Rossi, has not yet declared its presidential support for 2026.

item.title: https://istoe.com.br/kassab-defende-caiado-presidente-critica-lula-bolsonaro-sp
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, stated that Ronaldo Caiado, the party's pre-candidate for president, is the 'most complete' option and has a 'clean record' for the 2026 election, emphasizing his lack of accusations. He also criticized both Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Jair Bolsonaro, claiming Bolsonaro lacks vocation for public life. Kassab reaffirmed support for Tarcísio de Freitas' re-election in São Paulo and ruled out any alliance with the PT in the state.

item.title: A batalha entre direita e esquerda pela Avenida Paulista no 1º de Maio
item.description: São Paulo's Military Police banned left-wing demonstrations on Avenida Paulista for May 1st, authorizing only a right-wing act led by Patriotas do QG after a meeting with six social movements. The decision was justified by 'security concerns' in an election year, with threats to deploy the Shock Battalion and initiate legal action if the ban is violated. Left-wing groups criticized Governor Tarcísio de Freitas for allegedly favoring bolsonaristas.

item.title: Nikolas Ferreira critica Havaianas e divulga marca Pé Direito
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) criticized Havaianas in an Instagram story, promoting the Pé Direito brand, which emerged in response to the December 2025 controversy involving Fernanda Torres' ad. The Havaianas campaign was interpreted by some as a political stance against luck, prompting boycotts from Lula opposition figures. Ferreira endorsed Pé Direito as 'the brand of the Brazilian people,' featuring national flag colors in its sandal models.

item.title: Tarcísio reforça palanque para Flávio em SP: “1º evento de muitos”
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated that the Agrishow 2026 participation was the first of many events alongside Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the pre-candidate for Presidency, reinforcing Bolsonaro's platform in São Paulo. He announced joint events in Campinas, Sorocaba, and Presidente Prudente in May. Flávio praised Tarcísio, saying he 'God willing will one day be president of Brazil'.

item.title: Prazo para regularizar título de eleitor para votar em 2026 termina em 10 dias
item.description: The deadline to regularize voter registration ends on May 6, ensuring eligibility to vote in the 2026 elections. The TSE provides free online consultation via its portal, and the regularization process is completed through the Electoral Self-Service portal, requiring document submission and protocol tracking. Voters with irregular titles lose voting rights and face restrictions on public sector jobs, public office salaries, passports, ID cards, public school enrollment, and legal compliance verification.

item.title: Fluminense supera a Chapecoense e se mantém em 3º no Brasileirão
item.description: Fluminense defeated Chapecoense 2-1 at Maracanã in the 13th round of the 2026 Brasileirão, with goals from Savarino and John Kennedy. The win keeps Fluminense in third place with 26 points, while Chapecoense remains last with 8 points.

item.title: Ao vivo: governo inaugura centro de radioterapia no interior de SP
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin and Health Minister Alexandre Padilha attended the inauguration of the Radiotherapy Center at the Regional Hospital of Presidente Prudente, with President Lula participating remotely. The event also announced new oncology deliveries, 30 micro-buses for the SUS in São Paulo, SAMU ambulances, and mobile dental units — marking the federal government’s first national acquisition of health transport for macroregions.

item.title: Oposição quer que TCU investigue uso de R$ 4,5 milhões em acervo privado de Lula
item.description: The opposition has requested the TCU to investigate the use of R$ 4.5 million in federal public funds for organizing Lula’s private archive under a contract with UFABC. Deputy Ubiratan Sanderson (PL-RS) claims misuse of purpose, lack of transparency, and risk to public funds, arguing that public money should not benefit private assets without public access. The request includes a preliminary suspension of payments, contract interruption, and a special audit.

item.title: Alvaro Dias e Dallagnol lideram disputa ao Senado no PR
item.description: Alvaro Dias (MDB) and Deltan Dallagnol (Novo) lead the Senate race in Paraná, according to a Quaest poll released on April 27, 2026. The survey, with a 3-point margin of error and 95% confidence level, interviewed 1,104 voters between April 21 and 25. The TSE registration number is PR-02588/2026.

item.title: 'Irmão' de Zanin e Mendonça e perfil pacificador: o que esperar de Messias no Supremo
item.description: Jorge Messias, nominated by President Lula for the STF, is seen as a potential 'pacifier' due to his ability to navigate different ideological currents in the Court. His main allies are expected to be Cristiano Zanin (also appointed by Lula) and André Mendonça (appointed by Bolsonaro), whom he calls 'brother in faith'. Although he says he will vote according to conscience, his garantista profile aligns him with Gilmar Mendes, and he intends to avoid joining formal groups within the Supreme Court.

item.title: Caiado diz preferir que Zema concorra sozinho à presidência, mas evita descartar composição de chapa com ex-governador mineiro
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD pre-candidate for president, said he prefers Romeu Zema to run alone but did not rule out a joint ticket, arguing such a union would benefit the PT and Lula. He cited low name recognition — 53% of Brazilians don’t know him — as his main campaign hurdle and used the nationalist slogan 'I will deliver Brazil to Brazilians'. Caiado also reaffirmed his commitment to fiscal responsibility and reducing the size of Brasília.

item.title: Grêmio bate o Coritiba em sua arena pelo Brasileirão
item.description: Grêmio defeated Coritiba 1-0 in Porto Alegre in the 13th round of the 2026 Brasileirão, with Gabriel Mec scoring the only goal in the 42nd minute of the first half. The win moved Grêmio to 16 points in 11th place, while Coritiba remained in 7th with 19 points.

item.title: “Se Deus quiser, Tarcísio ainda vai ser presidente um dia”, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro praised Governor Tarcísio de Freitas at the Agrishow in Ribeirão Preto, advocating that his ally could one day become president of Brazil. He emphasized their political partnership and Tarcísio’s potential to lead the country in the future.

item.title: Lula desiste de participação por vídeo em eventos em SP e recebe líder do governo no Alvorada
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva withdrew from participating remotely in two events in the interior of São Paulo on Monday, the 27th, due to technical transmission issues. The Planalto Palace clarified that the decision was unrelated to his recovery from health procedures conducted the previous week. Lula received the government leader at the Alvorada Palace.

item.title: ‘Vocês não vão mais ouvir falar de Lula a partir de 2027’, diz Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-SP) positioned himself as the agribusiness candidate during an event in São Paulo alongside Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, pledging to support the sector and claiming that, from 2027 onward, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will no longer be politically relevant. He emphasized the need for a right-wing president and reaffirmed his commitment to agribusiness demands. This marked his second appearance at an agribusiness event in under two weeks, amid rising competition for the pre-candidacy with Ronaldo Caiado (PSD-GO).

item.title: Palmeiras vence o Bragantino fora de casa e se mantém líder do Brasileiro
item.description: Palmeiras defeated Bragantino 1-0 away from home in the 13th round of the 2026 Brazilian Championship, with Flaco López scoring the only goal in the 20th minute of the first half. The victory allowed Palmeiras to maintain the league lead with 32 points and an 82% performance rate. Bragantino remains in 9th place with 17 points.

item.title: Com dança das cadeiras, indicação de Messias ao STF avança na CCJ
item.description: The Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) reshuffle has strengthened the position of Jorge Messias, Lula’s nominee to the Supreme Court, securing 15 favorable votes against 7 opposed — just enough to advance to the full Senate. Although the majority is now consolidated, the margin remains tight, with four members still undeclared, including Rodrigo Pacheco (likely supportive) and Oriovisto Guimarães (likely opposed). Messias’s hearing is set for April 29; CCJ approval is required before a secret Senate vote, where 41 affirmative votes are needed for final confirmation.

item.title: Flávio diz que Lula trata agro como "lixo" e vê MDB "mais perto de cá"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the Lula government for treating agribusiness as 'trash', contrasting it with his father Jair Bolsonaro's administration, and praised the MDB for being 'closer to us', despite internal divisions between Lula allies and Bolsonaro supporters within the party. He also downplayed the government's R$10 billion credit line for agricultural machinery announced by Vice President Geraldo Alckmin at Agrishow, arguing that indebted rural producers need working capital loans at low interest, not just equipment financing.

item.title: Flávio e Tarcísio fazem 1ª agenda de pré-campanha juntos e colocam Bolsonaro como protagonista
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas and Flávio Bolsonaro attended the opening of Agrishow 2026 in Ribeirão Preto, reinforcing their political alliance and praising Jair Bolsonaro's legacy. Tarcísio stated that Flávio inherited Bolsonaro's values and called him the 'next president', while criticizing the Lula government for tax increases and expensive credit, defending private property and land regularization. Flávio signaled openness to the MDB, saying the party is closer to his political side than to Lula's government.

item.title: Os idosos do 8 de Janeiro que receberam prisão domiciliar por decisão de Moraes
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes granted house arrest to at least 18 elderly individuals convicted for their role in the January 8, 2023, attacks, including Maria de Fátima Souza, known as Fátima de Tubarão, sentenced to 17 years and who had already served over three years. The decision includes electronic ankle monitoring, bans on social media use, leaving Brazil, and contact with other participants in the attacks.

item.title: Mãe de Isabella Nardoni vai disputar vaga na Câmara dos Deputados
item.description: Ana Carolina Oliveira, mother of Isabella Nardoni and São Paulo city councilwoman from the Podemos party, announced her intention to run for a seat in the Chamber of Deputies in the 2026 elections. She aims to secure at least 500 thousand votes and become the party’s most-voted candidate, led by federal deputy Renata Abreu. Her platform focuses on early childhood and combating femicide, driven by her daughter’s 2008 murder.

item.title: Agro é “tratado como lixo pelo atual governo”, diz Flávio na Agrishow
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a pre-candidate for president, criticized the Lula government for treating agribusiness as 'trash' during the opening of Agrishow 2026 in Ribeirão Preto. He stated the sector is a solution for Brazil and accused Lula of lacking sensitivity, while praising his father Jair Bolsonaro’s government for carrying out the 'largest agrarian reform in history' and solving 'real people’s problems'.

item.title: Lindbergh se manifesta sobre volta do PL da Dosimetria ao Congresso
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) opposed the Dosimetria Bill, which returns to Congress for analysis of the presidential veto, warning that the proposal could lead to amnesty for January 8 coup plotters, including Jair Bolsonaro, and called the vote decisive for Brazilian democracy.

item.title: Veja os pontos principais do programa Desenrola 2, que pretende refinanciar dívidas e melhorar popularidade de Lula
item.description: The Lula government plans to launch Desenrola 2 on May 1st, a debt refinancing program targeting individuals earning up to five minimum wages, focusing on overdue credit card, overdraft, and personal loans. It offers interest rates below 2% monthly, discounts of 20% to 90% on total debt, allows up to 20% of FGTS funds to be used, and includes a government-backed credit guarantee fund with up to R$10 billion from the Treasury, excluding payroll and real estate loans.

item.title: Lindbergh convoca mobilização contra derrubada do veto ao PL da Dosimetria
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) called for street and social media mobilization to prevent the overturning of President Lula’s veto on the Dosimetria Bill, which would reduce sentences for those convicted of the January 8, 2023 attacks. He argues that maintaining the veto is essential to uphold accountability for anti-democratic acts.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Se Flávio quer derrotar Lula, a direita precisa parar de brigar, diz especialista
item.description: A specialist says that for Flávio to defeat Lula in the 2026 elections, the right must unite and stop internal fighting. Division within the right is seen as a greater obstacle than Lula’s candidacy itself. Unity is considered essential to build a competitive alternative.

item.title: TCU investiga destinação de R$ 4,5 milhões para montar acervo de Lula
item.description: The TCU has opened an investigation into the allocation of R$ 4.5 million in federal public funds to organize, digitize, and provisionally store the personal archive of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, under a Decentralized Execution Term between the Civil House and the Federal University of ABC. The Civil House’s press office stated the measure is supported by current legislation, while the tribunal may request clarifications and documents to verify proper use of the funds.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Tarcísio será presidente ‘um dia’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, a presidential pre-candidate, stated that Tarcísio de Freitas, governor of São Paulo, will be president 'one day' during a speech at Agrishow in Ribeirão Preto. He praised the Republican's ability to lead the country and criticized the Lula government for treating agribusiness as 'trash', asserting that the sector is a solution for Brazil and that Lula will become irrelevant from 2027 onward.

item.title: Em primeira agenda conjunta, Flávio e Tarcísio miram políticas rurais de Lula: ‘O agro não pode ser tratado como vilão’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and Governor Tarcísio de Freitas attended the Agrishow in their first joint public appearance, criticizing federal government policies under Lula for harming agribusiness through high interest rates and insufficient rural credit, while positioning the sector as a national solution. Vice President Geraldo Alckmin announced a R$ 10 billion credit line via Finep for agricultural machinery, with single-digit interest rates, to be disbursed within 20-30 days through cooperatives and accredited financial institutions. Flávio Bolsonaro pledged to prioritize agribusiness if elected president.

item.title: Pré-candidato, Cury visita Agrishow, que vira palco de presidenciáveis
item.description: Writer Augusto Cury, a pre-candidate for president from the Avante party, will visit the Agrishow in Ribeirão Preto on Monday (27), an event that has become a key platform for presidential hopefuls in 2026. The visit underscores candidates' strategy to seek support from the agribusiness sector, a crucial voter base in Brazilian elections.

item.title: ‘O tributo das bets é importante, mas não pode vir da desgraça das pessoas’, diz líder do PT
item.description: A PT leader advocates for banning betting houses in Brazil, stating that while regulation generated nearly R$10 billion in revenue in 2025, taxation should not come from the debt and suffering of families. The PT's bill aims to shut down all betting operators within 30 days, imposing fines up to R$2 billion and criminal liability, and notes the position was developed internally in the caucus without direct talks with President Lula.

item.title: Tarcísio endossa legado de Bolsonaro e projeta Flávio para presidência
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) endorsed the legacy of Jair Bolsonaro at Agrishow 2026, hailing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro as the 'next president' of Brazil. He emphasized the importance of agribusiness, criticized the left and the Lula government for raising taxes and making credit more expensive, and recalled his 2022 appearance alongside Bolsonaro at the event, reinforcing his alignment with bolsonarism.

item.title: Tarcísio de Freitas e Flávio Bolsonaro vão juntos à Agrishow em SP
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) attended the opening of Agrishow in Ribeirão Preto (SP) on April 27, 2026, marking the start of a joint political articulation for the October elections. The event also featured Alesp president André do Prado (PL) and deputy Guilherme Derrite (PP). Agrishow is Latin America's largest agribusiness fair.

item.title: O favoritismo de Moro e o paradoxo de Ratinho Junior no Paraná
item.description: Governor Ratinho Junior (PSD) enjoys high approval (80%) and 64% of Paraná voters believe he should choose a successor, yet his endorsed candidate, Sandro Alex (PSD), trails in fourth place with only 5% support, while Sergio Moro (União Brasil/PL) leads with 35%. Despite Moro’s lead, 67% of voters say their choice could change, and 78% are unaware of Sandro Alex, highlighting a paradox between the governor’s popularity and his candidate’s electoral weakness due to low name recognition.

item.title: Fantoches de Zema que irritaram Gilmar já eram usados por Agildo Ribeiro nos anos 80
item.description: The campaign video of Romeu Zema that irritated Minister Gilmar Mendes uses artificial intelligence to revive the political puppet satire technique, a format popularized internationally by Spitting Image and brought to Brazil by Agildo Ribeiro in the 1980s. Ribeiro used puppets of figures such as Sarney, Brizola, Lula, Collor, and Maluf in his show 'Agildo no País das Maravilhas,' which premiered in 1987 on TV Bandeirantes and featured an iconic opening theme. The content highlights the continuity of political satire in Brazil, linking historical practices to current digital tools.

item.title: Zema diz que depois do vídeo convidando Flávio Bolsonaro para vice ‘indagações diminuíram 90%’
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) said inquiries about him being Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) running mate dropped 90% after he jokingly invited the senator to be his vice president in a viral video. The video, filmed in April at the Liberty Forum in Porto Alegre and shared by federal deputy Marcel van Hattem, garnered 13 million Instagram views and marked their first personal meeting. Zema denied joining the PL ticket, insisted on running to the end, and said both he and Bolsonaro expect to face Lula in a potential second-round runoff.

item.title: Governo Lula destina R$ 909 milhões para agricultura familiar
item.description: The Lula government allocated R$ 909 million to family agriculture programs, including Pronaf Mais Leite (R$ 450 million for genetic improvement of livestock), Pronaf Agroindústria (R$ 15 million for a powdered milk unit), PAA (R$ 100 million for nearly 2,000 tons of powdered milk), a new Pronaf credit line (R$ 150 million), an Ater public call (R$ 28.5 million), and Incra installation credits (R$ 155 million). Two presidential decrees for social interest expropriation were also signed to create settlements in São Paulo and Ceará, benefiting thousands of families.

item.title: Manifesto do PT ignora corrupção e defende socialismo democrático no Brasil
item.description: The PT's nearly 3,500-word manifesto completely ignores systemic corruption linked to the party, including INSS scandals and excessive corporate card spending, blaming Brazil's problems on the 'exhaustion of the neoliberal model' and the 'crisis of capitalism'. The text defends democratic socialism as the solution, arguing that social frustration fuels authoritarianism from the far-right, without acknowledging the role of past PT administrations in deteriorating public services and increasing national debt.

item.title: Temer diz que polarização chegou ao STF e que Gilmar não deveria ter respondido Zema
item.description: Former President Michel Temer (MDB) stated that political polarization has reached the Supreme Federal Court (STF) and criticized Justice Gilmar Mendes for responding to criticisms from former governor Romeu Zema (Novo-MG). Temer suggested that Mendes should have maintained the impartiality expected of a Court member.

item.title: Crusoé: Nexus indica o candidato mais anti-Lula e anti-Bolsonaro
item.description: BTG/Nexus poll shows Renan Santos, founder of MBL, as the pre-candidate with the highest voting intention among voters who are anti-Lula and anti-Bolsonaro, at 3% to 4%. Released on Monday, the 27th, the survey positions him as the most representative option for voters rejecting both major political poles. The original post appeared on O Antagonista.

item.title: PSD está feliz com Tarcísio e chance de se aliar ao PT em SP é ‘zero’, diz Kassab
item.description: PSD national president Gilberto Kassab stated the party will support the unconditional re-election of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and ruled out any chance of an alliance with the PT in São Paulo, calling the possibility 'zero'. He expressed satisfaction with Tarcísio’s performance, despite leaving the Government Secretariat in March due to disagreements over the governor’s alignment with Bolsonarism. Kassab reiterated that the PSD will remain actively involved in Tarcísio’s campaign, regardless of its position on the ticket.

item.title: Flávio e Tarcísio săo recebidos com aplausos e festa em feira do agro em SP
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) were greeted with applause and celebration at the Agrishow, the national agribusiness fair, in Ribeirão Preto, São Paulo. Their second joint public appearance strengthens their emerging alliance as potential allies in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Wellington Dias deixa ministério para reforçar articulação por Jorge Messias no STF
item.description: Minister of Social Development Wellington Dias is stepping down to politically advocate for Attorney General Jorge Messias’ STF nomination, aiming to reduce Senate resistance, particularly from allies of Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. Messias’ confirmation hearing is scheduled for May 29 in the CCJ, with a plenary vote the same day. The government expects 48 favorable votes — above the 41 needed — but acknowledges uncertainty due to Centrón opposition and support for Rodrigo Pacheco.

item.title: A retomada do julgamento no STF sobre denúncia contra Silas Malafaia
item.description: The STF resumed the trial of the complaint against pastor Silas Malafaia for insult and slander against Army High Command officials, after Minister Cristiano Zanin requested a view, nullifying the virtual votes. Rapporteur Alexandre de Moraes had previously voted to accept the complaint, stating that Malafaia’s April 2025 remarks — calling generals a 'bunch of weaklings', 'cowards', and 'omissive' — constitute a crime with minimal evidence of authorship and just cause. The First Chamber, composed of Moraes, Zanin, Flávio Dino, and Cármen Lúcia, restarts the trial from zero this Tuesday (28).
